working_tasks.authority: lightweight-mode active working state; compatibility cache in governed mode

turn_deltas.authority: buffered per-turn changed-path deltas awaiting a flush

creatable.via: context.py context-save from curated JSON and, for detail full, an explicit visible transcript export
any context.py command that opens the runtime
approved Memory Bank capture or promotion
context.py start, brain-create, or supported update operations

portable_handoff: python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py context-save --input INPUT.json --output tasks/TASK-NNN/context-save-TIMESTAMP.md --detail summary --source-client CLIENT --json
python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py context-save --input INPUT.json --output tasks/TASK-NNN/context-save-TIMESTAMP.md --detail topic --topic TOPIC --source-client CLIENT --json
python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py context-save --input INPUT.json --output tasks/TASK-NNN/context-save-TIMESTAMP.md --detail full --source-client CLIENT --transcript VISIBLE-EXPORT.md --json

checkpoint.governed_authority: turn updates the governed task auto-checkpoint through the runtime; it never completes the task
checkpoint.lightweight_authority: start/update/get/clear/complete operate SQLite working_tasks; checkpointing is CLI-backed and no checkpoints.jsonl file exists

dynamic_records: python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py brain-create TYPE --external-id ID --title TITLE

purposes.python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py s: show local context index counts for the procedural, semantic and episodic layers
show local context index counts for the procedural, semantic and episodic layers as machine-readable output
purposes.python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py v: validate active and archived Brain records, the governed control plane and the repository index
purposes.python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py p: compare the canonical mirrors across editions and fail on drift in mirrored skills, hooks, commands, agents or governance documents
purposes.python3 memory-bank/scripts/validate.py: validate the durable memory bank: chunk frontmatter, statuses and the bank index
print durable memory bank status counts from chunk frontmatter without printing chunk contents
purposes.python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py c: create one exclusive-new portable summary handoff from a curated payload, writing only the named artifact
create one exclusive-new portable topic handoff from a curated payload, writing only the named artifact
create one exclusive-new portable full handoff from a curated payload and explicit visible transcript export, writing only the named artifact
validate one explicit portable handoff and report source-fingerprint drift without loading transcript content or writing files
validate one explicit portable handoff, include its explicit visible transcript, and report source-fingerprint drift without writing files

python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py s.meaning: prints the document, episode and working-task counts per layer
prints the same counts as JSON with the mode and the authority

python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py v.meaning: every Brain record and index is canonical and it says validation passed
prints each record or index that is stale or non-canonical

python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py p.meaning: the canonical mirrors agree, or the edition is standalone and parity is skipped
prints the mirrored files that drifted between editions

python3 memory-bank/scripts/validate.py.meaning: the durable memory bank passes chunk frontmatter and status validation; non-fatal warnings may still be printed to stderr
prints each chunk error that failed validation
prints the durable memory bank chunk status counts

python3 memory-bank/scripts/context.py c.meaning: creates the new portable summary handoff and reports its path
reports invalid curated input, unsafe content, or an existing output path without changing runtime state
creates the new portable topic handoff and reports its path
reports invalid topic or curated input, unsafe content, or an existing output path without changing runtime state
creates the new full handoff with the explicit visible transcript and reports its path
reports missing, unsafe, or invalid transcript/input or an existing output path without changing runtime state
prints validated curated context and source-fingerprint drift without transcript content
reports malformed or unsafe input without changing runtime state
prints validated curated context, explicit visible transcript, and source-fingerprint drift
reports malformed or unsafe input without changing runtime state

owns: sanitized CLI-backed turn checkpoint or explicit governed skip
curated context and an explicit visible transcript for detail full
